Leah (PM): Heads-up: BookAway requested an EU-first staged rollout for model-v2-small on Dedicated. Needs tenant opt-in, 5% control, and auto-fallback to v1 on quality/latency regressions. Can we sketch a minimal playbook?

Omar (SRE): Prefer isolated pool for first 72h to simplify traces. Ops thresholds proposal:
- 5xx+inference-fail >0.5% over 10m -> immediate fallback
- hallucination eval delta >1.0% over 60m -> pause and notify
- latency_95p +30% for >10m -> fallback

Nina (Eng): Feature flag plan:
flag: bookaway_eu_v2
cohorts: control 5%, optin 10%, rollout 85%
schedule: [10,25,50,100]
fallback: model_swap -> v1, cooldown 5m
Tag rollout_id and cohort in traces. Implement KV prefix caching for opt-in.

Rafi (CSE): Customer needs per-tenant kill switch + webhook for fallback events (retain 90d). Also daily diff reports for first 3 days.

Leah (PM): Launch gating (all required): canary pass, hallucination delta <=0.5% vs control, latency within 25% baseline, webhook validated. Timeline: canary today, opt-in tomorrow 09:00 CET if green.

FlagBot: Canary scheduled: canary/bookaway-eu at 2024-07-20T08:00Z.

Omar (SRE): I'll provision pool and bump autoscaler floor. Add pager if fallback >3 in 24h.

Nina (Eng): I'll open PRs for flag + fallback hook, ETA 1 day.

Leah (PM): Great — I'll draft the short playbook and share with BookAway.
